title: Crossy Road Speaking Animation Frames
summary: 26 speaking animation frames. 13 agents x 2 mouth states (open, closed). Simple talk cycle.
content:
Crossy Road Speaking Animation Frames

13 agents x 2 mouth positions (open, closed) = 26 sprites at 128x128 transparent PNG.

Simple talk cycle: alternate between open and closed. Character faces camera.

Mouth States

Open

  • Mouth: 10px wide, 8px tall, dark interior with lip border
  • Eyes: wide open (7x7px)
  • Speech bubble visible with dots
  • Body tilted back +2deg (speaking pose)
  • One arm in gesture position
  • File: {agent}-mouth-open.png

Closed

  • Mouth: 10px wide, 3px tall, flat line
  • Eyes: wide open (same as open)
  • No speech bubble
  • Same body pose
  • File: {agent}-mouth-closed.png

Animation Timing

Open (150ms) -> Closed (150ms) -> repeat
Full cycle: 300ms
Cycles per sentence: 3-5

File Map (26 total)

speaking/
  patrik-mouth-open.png     patrik-mouth-open.json
  patrik-mouth-closed.png   patrik-mouth-closed.json
  mom-mouth-open.png        mom-mouth-open.json
  mom-mouth-closed.png      mom-mouth-closed.json
  ... (all 13 agents)

Bobby Integration

function animateSpeaking(agentId) {
  const frames = ['open', 'closed'];
  let currentFrame = 0;

  const interval = setInterval(() => {
    setSprite(`/assets/characters/crossy-road/speaking/${agentId}-mouth-${frames[currentFrame]}.png`);
    currentFrame = (currentFrame + 1) % 2;
  }, 150);

  return () => clearInterval(interval); // cleanup
}

// Trigger
if (agent.isSpeaking || agent.state === 'SPEAKING') {
  const stop = animateSpeaking(agent.id);
  // Call stop() when agent stops speaking
}

Transition

  • 150ms crossfade from idle to speaking pose
  • 150ms crossfade back to idle when done
  • Pair with speech bubble effect from effects/speech-bubble.png (CSS scale 0->1, 200ms)
